caption: The drawing features a single glass goblet placed at the center of the composition, depicted in a light greenish color with clear shading to indicate transparency and gloss. The goblet has a flared bowl, a slender stem with a decorative ring near the middle, and a broad, flat base. The background is a plain, off-white color. There are two inset diagrams drawn in thin lines: one in the upper left corner showing a top-down circular view of the goblet, and one in the lower right corner showing a side profile cross-section of the goblet, highlighting the shape of both the stem and the base. The entire drawing is bordered by a thin rectangular frame, with the artist’s name, "Edward Wilson," written in the bottom left corner.
title: Whiskey Glass
